subject.title: feat(cli): add openclaw agent exec headless one-shot runner

question: Should OpenClaw support `agent exec` as a stable, isolated, host-capable public automation interface with this default policy and output contract?
rationale: The PR creates a new user-facing command, flags, JSON schema, state/auth defaults, and execution boundary; automated checks cannot decide the intended long-term product contract.

options.title: Sponsor the interface
options.body: Approve this as the supported headless automation entry point after the security disposition and live behavior proof are attached.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep the useful runner but reduce or revise the default host-execution, auth, or output guarantees before accepting it as public API.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause the PR until maintainers choose a broader automation/agent-runner direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the interface
recommendation.body: Approve this as the supported headless automation entry point after the security disposition and live behavior proof are attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history identifies this person as author of the proposed command and its command-routing changes.
